nodes.label: New school website prototype
nodes.rationale: Mobile LCP 2.7 s (about 9x faster, later fixed to <=2 s), desktop 0.6 s. 1.4 MB in 25 files. Thai/English, 16 linked pages, one tap to admissions and phone, real photos from the school page, a source cited on every page. It is static files with no database, so it is easy to hand over and can move to a university server. Still a prototype with less content than the old site.

nodes.rationale: Mobile LCP 23.6 s (desktop 4.8 s). Home page is 9.9 MB in 114 files (15 images = 6.2 MB, 29 CSS, 49 scripts). The phone number is about 7 screens down and cannot be tapped to call, and admissions info takes 3 taps. It accepts plain http with no HSTS. Its strengths, stated for credibility: Best Practices 100, a bot-blocking firewall, and more archived content.

nodes.label: OWASP ASVS 5.0 Level 1
nodes.rationale: Minimum web security baseline; 3 items checkable from outside: old site passes 0/3, new site 3/3. Checked from headers only, no intrusion.

nodes.label: Parent's Mobile Experience

nodes.label: PDPA and Student Photo Policy

nodes.label: Poster design service (add-on)
nodes.rationale: Real school photos and colours, all information on one page, every QR tested, online and print files. Prices (still awaiting owner confirmation): 490 THB per piece, 1,490 THB per month (4 posters plus a web news post each), 14,900 THB per school year. The website itself is given free. The new QR goes to the same link as the old poster's, decoded and regenerated sharper; a direct form link is requested to replace the free link-shortener.
